name: trigger-source
description: Test plugin: the trigger source fixture. On its own timer it reads new lines of the file CAPCOMD_TEST_TRIGGER_INBOX names (emit a trigger, subscribe or unsubscribe a run), keeping its place in ctx.storage, denies at trigger.admitting a trigger whose data says policy deny, and writes what it got and heard to CAPCOMD_TEST_TRIGGER_LOG.
